description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Applied Intuition is powering the future of physical AI and developing digital infrastructure for intelligent moving machines. The company is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to develop production embedded software for next-generation vehicle platforms, including RTOS applications, real-time C code, hardware bring-up, and custom device software. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to productionize and maintain company products.
Embedded software engineer developing safety-critical RTOS firmware, integrating hardware interfaces, and debugging new devices

Responsibilities:
• Integrate vendor components into a common software framework, ensuring proper low-level communication (e.g., CAN, LIN, I2C, SPI, UART etc.)
• Implement real-time operating system (RTOS) applications as required for the product
• Architect and develop high-quality C code for real-time embedded environments, including safety critical systems
• Support hardware bring-up, including low level debug of board and SoC
• Work with cross-functional teams to bring up custom software on new devices, productionize it, and manage the process for maintaining company products

Requirements:
• BS/BA, MS, or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related degree graduating by December 2026 or Summer 2027
• Strong background in embedded software development using C/C++ and assembly languages
• Ability to do low-level debugging on hardware to ensure complete system operation
• 1+ year of experience in any field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred:
• Proven ability as a self-starter and can quickly become comfortable with new technical tools
• Experience taking initiative in a fast-paced environment
• Hands-on experience with RTOS and middleware applications
• Ability to work with safety critical robotic systems with real time constraints
